finding: Both wrist cameras are black in the policy's observation when num_envs=10; they are correct at num_envs=1.
why_it_matters: eval_env.get_obs_batch feeds _stream_vision the same dict it returns to the policy, so the recorded video is the policy input. Two of three camera views were blank for the whole 42-cell sweep.

num_envs_10.pattern: per episode exactly one wrist frame is all-zero (max=[0,0,0]) and the other is 2-5; which side is zero alternates between episodes
num_envs_10.note: the non-zero wrist is grey (max=[88,88,88]) i.e. no albedo, same signature as the earlier texture-streaming defect

official_recorded_reference.conclusion: camera mount/intrinsics config matches the official recording; only the rendered pixels differ

ruled_out: GPU memory: policy+env on one card peaks at 40GB of 80GB, and splitting them across cards changes nothing
tile index arithmetic: RoboDojo _get_tiled_resolution gives (2560,1440) for 10x 640x480, identical to what Kit 107.3.3 render_product_tiled computes, so num_tiles_x=4 is right
wrist camera pose/intrinsics config: matches the official recording exactly
invalidates: Pi_05 1.10% and G05 1.57% (42/42 cells each) were measured with two blind cameras and cannot be compared to the published 6.91% / 14.88%.
